_about: Approved audiobook contraction registry. The build gate enforces CANON = AUDIO TEXT + APPROVED CONTRACTION REGISTRY + DECLARED AUTHOR CORRECTIONS. A canonical line may be absent from the audio only if an APPROVED record here claims it. Nothing is cut by editorial judgement alone.
invariant: CANON = AUDIO TEXT + APPROVED CONTRACTION REGISTRY + DECLARED AUTHOR CORRECTIONS

notes: Provenance observation only, not a finding: the quoted Author message uses typographic dashes in ch. 13 and plain hyphens in ch. 15. Punctuation alone does not establish the direction of copying; hyphens may have entered at any intermediate copying or formatting stage.
